mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO creator_post_like (post_id, user_id) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM creator_post_like WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM creator_post_like WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND user_id = #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE creator_post SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{postId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
UPDATE creator_post SET like_count = GREATEST(like_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{postId}
UPDATE creator_post SET comment_count = comment_count + 1 WHERE id = #{postId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
UPDATE creator_post SET comment_count = GREATEST(comment_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{postId}
